newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times page one - Oct 9.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times page one - Oct 9.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Wednesday:
* Pope John Paul II's chief surgeon removed the pontiff's appendix in an operation that found no traces of any new or serious ailment.
* U.S. Republican presidential candidate Bob Dole is emphasising economic rather than social issues in his campaign against President Bill Clinton.
* New York State is losing about $1 million a day in welfare grants because it has not presented a plan showing how it intends to comply with the new federal welfare law.
